# Select focus with priority for counties with less presence of councillor's liege culture
# Scope : county
E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_select_default_focus = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_county_province = {
                T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_can_convert_province = yes
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_ai_select_for_liege }
                    T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_ai_would_suggest = yes
                }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province }
                    NOT = { scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province = this }
                }
            }
        }
        scope:councillor_liege.culture = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture } # used by V_kCAFG_province_culture_factor in V_kCAFG_steward_promotion_default_focus_province_score
        ordered_county_province = {
            limit = {
                T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_can_convert_province = yes
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_ai_select_for_liege }
                    T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_ai_would_suggest = yes
                }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province }
                    NOT = { scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province = this }
                }
            }
            order_by = V_kCAFG_steward_promotion_default_focus_province_score
            save_scope_as = kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_can_redirect
            scope:councillor_liege = {
                any_realm_province = {
                    T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_can_convert_province = yes
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_ai_select_for_liege }
                        T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_ai_would_suggest = yes
                    }
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province }
                        NOT = { scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province = this }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        scope:councillor_liege.culture = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture } # used by V_kCAFG_province_culture_factor in V_kCAFG_steward_promotion_default_focus_province_score
        scope:councillor_liege = {
            ordered_realm_province = {
                limit = {
                    T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_can_convert_province = yes
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_ai_select_for_liege }
                        T_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_ai_would_suggest = yes
                    }
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province }
                        NOT = { scope:kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province = this }
                    }
                }
                order_by = V_kCAFG_steward_promotion_default_focus_province_score
                save_scope_as = kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
            }
        }
    }
}

# Set focus with priority for counties with less presence of councillor's liege culture
# Scope : county
E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_set_default_focus = {
    E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_select_default_focus = yes
    scope:councillor = { E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_set_focus = { PROVINCE = scope:kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus } }
    clear_saved_scope = kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
}

# Scope : character
E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_set_focus = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = $PROVINCE$ }

        set_variable = {
            name = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
            value = $PROVINCE$
        }

        # Redirect task to proper target depending on selected focused province
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    NOT = { is_performing_council_task = task_promote_culture }
                    NOT = { councillor_task_target = var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.county.title_province }
                }
            }
            set_council_task = {
                task_type = task_promote_culture
                target = var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.county.title_province
            }
        }
        
    }
    else = {
        debug_log = "Kei CAFG - task_promote_culture: could not set default focus: clear focus and start default task"
        remove_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province
        start_default_task = yes
    }
}
